page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.e3.7xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 32 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, resulting in an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. This architecture favors workloads that require substantial operating memory per execution thread without relying on shared-core CPU bursting.

Hardware capabilities do not include local disk storage or graphical processing units, provisioning 0 GB of local storage and zero GPUs. Workloads deployed on ecs.e3.7xlarge rely entirely on external network-attached block storage for operating system and data volumes. The instance also provisions zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating configured network routing or assigned Elastic IPs for direct internet communication.

The qualitative efficiency profile centers on high memory density per compute unit. By omitting specialized hardware accelerators and onboard NVMe arrays, resource overhead is dedicated toward memory capacity. The instance is suited for memory-bound systems such as in-memory databases, large-scale distributed caching nodes, memory-intensive data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) routines, and enterprise application backends.
